summary: Most of the frustration centres on navigation accuracy and reliability, followed by data accuracy and localization and user interface and experience. Users report frequent route miscalculations, loss of location tracking, and unexpected detours that increase travel time. AI integration is seen as a source of instability and inaccuracy in navigation.

themes.name: Data Accuracy and Localization
themes.description: Users report outdated satellite imagery, incorrect place names (e.g., Lake America instead of Lake Ontario), and poor map coverage in certain regions like Germany. Data accuracy is a major concern for travelers and local users.
themes.recommendation: Improve data localization, update satellite imagery, and ensure accurate naming conventions across regions.

themes.name: Navigation Accuracy and Reliability
themes.description: Users report frequent route miscalculations, loss of location tracking, and unexpected detours that increase travel time. AI integration is seen as a source of instability and inaccuracy in navigation.
themes.recommendation: Improve route prediction algorithms and stabilize AI integration to ensure consistent navigation performance.

themes.name: Offline Functionality
themes.description: Users report limitations in offline map usage, especially for long trips or in areas with poor connectivity. Competitors like HERE and OSM are seen as better for offline navigation.
themes.recommendation: Improve offline map capabilities and ensure full functionality without internet access.

quotes.text: google maps will (seems to?) consider current traffic when suggesting a route, which is a big plus for having a server connection. Might be not enough to prefer online navigation to offline, but it is a reason.

Interactivity mostly. Imagine if Google Maps reloaded every time you zoom in or pick a location.

themes.name: User Interface and Experience
themes.description: Users complain about intrusive ads, forced AI features, and lack of customization options like voice preferences. The UI is perceived as cluttered and less intuitive compared to competitors.
themes.recommendation: Simplify UI, reduce ads, and offer more customization options to enhance user experience.

themes.name: Privacy and Data Usage
themes.description: Users are concerned about data collection, especially with the integration of AI and Gemini. There is a demand for more transparency and control over personal data usage.
themes.recommendation: Enhance privacy controls and provide clearer data usage policies to build user trust.
